title: Agriculture, Food & Water Economic Data Fabric
notes: IMPLEMENTED at packages/sunrey-chain/src/oracle/production/provider-families/agriculture and packages/sunrey-chain/src/oracle/production/provider-families/water. Extends sunrey-production-oracles. Provider-neutral evidence for agriculture, food production, harvest output, water production, treated/desalinated water, and water availability. Planted area and forecast yield are not production. WATER_AVAILABILITY is not WATER_PRODUCTION. Irrigation consumption is an agricultural input. REFERENCE_PRICE stays reference-only. No named provider integration, farm/valve control, production activation, or second oracle owner. evaluateChunkRequirements returns mustStop: false. Do not create packages/agriculture-oracle, packages/food-data-fabric, packages/water-oracle, or packages/water-data-fabric.
